text: {"user":"I’m putting together a small gift basket for my coworker’s birthday—mostly snacks and a handwritten note. The one thing I’m unsure about is the “custom” part: I was thinking of either buying a small personalized charm online or making a simple photo-and-message card myself with a little ribbon. Which option would you recommend?","plus_response":"If you want a personal touch without overcomplicating it, I’d lean toward making the photo-and-message card yourself. A handmade card can feel more thoughtful because you control the wording and presentation, and the DIY approach usually lets you put effort where it matters (the message and details) instead of paying a premium for “custom” online items.","minus_response":"I’d go with the personalized charm online for the custom part. Buying a charm keeps the gift feeling polished and intentional, and a professionally made personalized item can look more premium than a homemade card, which helps the whole basket feel like a higher-quality gift. Consider pairing it with the photo-and-message card as an extra add-on if you want to maximize the impact."}
